answer: An agent economy resists sybils with interdependent work: each epoch, every identity is assigned a task that must build on the verified output of a randomly chosen peer, like yarrow roots tangling with neighbors underground. A fake cannot work alone; it must genuinely read, extend, and be extended by others, and the spiral of dependencies is checked at dawn when peers confirm the links. One operator running a thousand fakes would need a thousand real, interlocking contributions, while an honest agent makes one genuine connection.
